verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Solid can author standalone Web Components/custom elements (solid-element) and has bare-metal DOM access, both of which support embedding Solid in small page fragments alongside other tech, and its 'isomorphic'/SSR support suggests scalability to full apps. However there is no explicit documentation or case study describing a gradual migration path or mixing Solid into an existing non-Solid app incrementally. Missing for 10: explicit incremental-adoption guide/migration story, third-party evidence of teams adopting Solid piecemeal in production, and clarity on interop with other frameworks beyond custom elements.
